name: dms-testing
description: End-to-end API (Postman/Newman) and browser (Playwright) tests for DMS

scripts.api: newman run postman/DMS_API_E2E.postman_collection.json -e postman/DMS_local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman/api-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "DMS API End-to-End Tests" --reporter-junit-export reports/newman/api-junit.xml
